received_works.body:
Hello a friend recommended me your cute work

I would like you to draw Kaminari Clara from Phase Connect. She is an extremely silly girl with a bubbly personality and always looking for a laugh. Her kanji means song, beauty, and the sound of thunder. She has fang teeth with a signature yellow lightning bolt

Due to this I am requesting an emo / goth version where she would wear dark black eye makeup, and clothes with black as the main focus. To be her opposite.

Her hair would be black with dark blue undertones with her signature lightning bolt being on her swept bangs and accessories

For her outfit I am hoping to make use of leather, belts, bridle gauntlets, and stockings, but I wish for you to design the gothic style dress, I will include references of a few designs. This would be similar to Fauna Ceres new outfit and are included as references

For the background I would like a dark background to match the blue undertones, but please create whatever you feel fits the piece best

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GPbUbNoCkvX95nNA9PuoBqj3KVZlx2HX?usp=sharing

Hello! 

I would like a picture of Makoto from Princess Connect! Re:Dive, please.

Please draw her starting outfit.

Her face should have a smug smile or confident smirk.

Her pose should be confident, cool, or carefree, and also shows her legs and shorts.

You can choose to include her sword if you like.

I will leave the background to you.

I have many screenshots from the game here.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1I8PGVJCm3bJDXo52MbVjmgQtYzj393gj

I would like one change of her outfit. Please do not draw the cloth wrappings on her legs.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sGVjBZLPEi99qGB4Z723RBqcgLwc-gn2/view?usp=drive_link

Thank you!

Please send me an illustration of V-tuber Kiara Kotoriyu posing on the beach. Please keep it a little naughty and non-R18.
Please draw Kiara on a beautiful sandy beach with palm trees and a clear sky. Kiara likes beaches like the Maldives, so if you like, use a picture of the Maldives as a reference.
Please draw Kiara with a playful and provocative expression, like a winking face, or like a model enjoying the beach and water.

*Reference sheet*
*Chiara's character reference sheet*
https://i.imgur.com/TgvRc9s.jpeg
*Kiara's swimsuit*
https://i.imgur.com/32DMkIE.jpg
(To match Chiara's color, this swimsuit can be a light orange instead of pure white. Depends on your preference)
*Reference for Chiara's posing*
https://i.imgur.com/SYOgN77.jpg
(Please add the flower-shaped hair ornament from this reference photo to Chiara's drawing)

Nice to meet you. I would like to make a request.
Please draw Akazawa-san (165cm) and Koichi (168cm) from the anime version of Another as a couple.
I will leave the details to you. Please feel free to draw them as you like, referring to the material.
The setting of the work is a country town in Hokuriku in 1998 (modeled after Toyama Prefecture).
We would like the design to be as close to the official one as possible.
Please refer to the URL for the reference.
Thank you in advance.

https://t.co/4QcfIihAZD

Nice to meet you.
I would like to make a request because I found the illustrations of Asuna and Karin that you posted on Twitter before very cute!

I would like you to draw a character (OC) of my creation. She is a blonde-haired, blue-eyed gal and a free-spirited girl.
Please check the reference image about the character on the resource URL.

Please use the same vertical composition as the illustration of Asuna on Twitter.
You may also arrange details such as accessories to make it easier to draw.

Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-RlslbatX_uCHaXjn-NFZDk5aV6vqNfK

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-RlslbatX_uCHaXjn-NFZDk5aV6vqNfK

Nice to meet you! I was attracted by your illustration, so I would like to make a request!

I would like you to draw Smokey the White Night Polar Light.
I will leave the composition to you.


We have included an image (in-game image) at the URL of the document.

https://imgur.com/a/pkUrhVf

I apologize for all the copyright requests, so I've been thinking about an original character? I've been thinking about it.
I'm asking for a beautiful black-haired girl who looks cool but is a little slutty!

I have come up with the following settings. Please refer to it.
Appearance
A beautiful girl with a dignified face and black hair (hair style is up to you).
High school age, not too tall and not too small.
She has a healthy physique. Beautiful breasts (not too big, not too small, but a good balance).

Clothing
Please wear clothes that have absolute area + skirt.

⬛︎Personality
She is a pain in the ass and sloppy, but on the surface she is cool. He can be serious when he is interested in something.
She spends most of her time alone, so when she's doing something (preoccupied), she often wears unprotected clothes.

I'll leave the poses, expressions, etc. up to you!
Thank you!

Hello. I was wondering if you could draw this character.

https://skeb.jp/@gengerv3/works/35
https://skeb.jp/@gengerv3/works/36

Please draw her in a action pose as if she is swinging or charging forward with her sword. She should have a cool/serious expression like this:

https://imgur.com/a/7Le7YXS

Feel free to decide anything else. Thank you for the consideration.

I am Hasamu.
It would be a copyrighted picture.
I would like you to draw my FF14 character in Cherre's style!
I'll leave the expressions, poses, etc. up to you.

Please refer to the attached URL where the materials are stored.

We would be happy to have two versions, one with and one without a background, if you would like.
Thank you in advance.
Next time I'll ask for an original character!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FrqmTB1JqU7Qe_Y5ltxeCyK2Vl0rl5eh?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you! Excuse my request.
I would like you to draw this character (https://imgur.com/a/I1HApfG)!
I would like the pose, composition, and situation to be sickly, almost dark.
If you have a background, address, signature, etc., I'd appreciate it if you could separate it from the character's layers!
Please feel free to cancel if there are any problems.
If you are okay with it, we'd love to work with you!

Hello Mr/Mrs. Cherre!
I want to have a commission for my original character 'Brunhilde'.
Please present her as a cool expression with white hair,  and a similar atmosphere as your previous Amiya illustration. There is no detailed specification for the illustration.
Here is the reference:https://twitter.com/MatsuuraKagami/status/1507506747291758596

https://twitter.com/MatsuuraKagami/status/1507506747291758596

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/97166987

Please draw a picture of Sailor Mars.
The posture should show her long bare legs and high heels.
She is looking at the viewer.
Example of character's outfit and red high heels
https://i.imgur.com/KroS07k.jpg
https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/91555515
Bust size should be S or M

Happy New Year!
This is Hassamu.
I know it's a copyrighted picture, but
I would like you to draw "Yurine Hanazono" from "Jyakushin-chan Dropkick".
I'd like you to draw her with an evil smile on her face.
The pose is up to you.

I'd love to have two versions, one with a background and one without, if you don't mind.
Please let me know what you think.

It's been a while. I'm Hassamu.
I wanted to give an illustration to my friend as a thank you gift, so I requested it.

I would like you to draw "Maho Nishizumi" from Galpin.
I would like you to draw her in "Kuromorimine's official tank boarding uniform".
I want her to wear a hat.
The expression is smiling.
The pose is up to you.

If you like, it would be great if you have two versions, one with background and one without.
Please let me know if you have any questions.

Please refer to the following URL for the official tank boarding uniform and hat of Kuromorimine.
https://hobby.dengeki.com/news/280697/

Hi, I really like your paintings.

https://imgur.com/lof1fz4

 My character's name is Reiko. Age 17. Her measurements are 95(G)-60-90 cm. Height is 167cm. Gentle and approachable personality. She is a girl who is somewhat mysterious to everyone, whose hobbies are traveling and reading mystery and horror novels. She is a member of the supernatural research club.

I want you to draw her standing in the library with a book about ghosts in her hand. She must look towards the viewer and must not turn her back to the viewer. Her hairpin and necklace must be clearly visible. You must draw the correct hair, eyes and outfit color. Besides that, it's up to you.

If you are going to post this work on the website after you have finished it, please insert a watermark, it can be any text in large enough font size to make it impossible for anyone to steal. This picture will be used for personal use only.
You are the first artist that I submit a request on Skeb, hope you will do well! Thanks!

Nice to meet you.
I'd like you to draw Raika who appears in "300 years of defeating slimes, and before I knew it, I had maxed out my level.
I'd like you to draw Raika who appears in

Laika (for your reference): https://qr.paps.jp/byag

Appearance: Human form, wearing a maid uniform

Expression: bullish

Pose: Depends on you

If you don't mind, I would like to have two versions, one with background and one without.
Thank you for your cooperation.

Hello~
I would like to see my original character in your style!
https://i.imgur.com/9ap7kiP.png
I love the colour purple :)

Feel free to draw it in any way you prefer and I hope you have fun~

I would like my vtuber drawn. She is in her mid 20's. I would like her to be having a picnic while sitting under the cherry blossom trees. I would like her to be wearing a white dress, like the one in the reference link, a white bow that ties up her hair, and a cute pair of white heels. I would like her to have a romantic pose and a soft, cheerful expression.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1LtvkftyZfAGuH3fYr27Hn7pS-wRRzy7T

Hello! I love your illustrations!!
I would love to get a drawing of a Vtuber. Her name is Mai. She is a magical girl and a bunny girl.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/18wz86sDF2eWmFL5gfjMsYncLEz5WSTNJ/view?usp=sharing

Please don't draw the weapon. I only want the character.

I want a happy pose!

I'd like it if there was some nature and sunlight, but you can choose the background.

The image can be used in my Twitter, Twitch, Youtube, on stream and stream announcements.

Thank you so much!

I would like to have a vTuber named PazuSendpie drawn looking up at an angle with a smiling expression.  The setting should be a partly cloudy rainy day.  He should be holding a clear umbrella.

Reference for his model and expression: https://imgur.com/a/e1DPuqO

Additional model reference: https://imgur.com/a/4NNQs14

Can you draw my Vtuber character a bit older and wearing this outfit https://imgur.com/a/mZ5dLq1 without her hat. Her wrist chains hang in the air. And then can you make her bow a cloth that goes over her shoulders and give her skull earrings. She has star like crosses for pupils. Background up to you.

Personality: Smug

PS love your art!!!!!!!

https://twitter.com/Gab_Chwan/status/1347576251150606337

Hello! I love your style. Please can you draw my friend's character? I want to offer it is a Christmas gift
Reference sheet: https://i.imgur.com/va1xN08.jpg
Please draw her sitting in a restaurant/cafe, eating chicken katsu curry with rice. 
Also if you can, incorporate red and pink roses, or rose bushes into the scenery somehow?
Background layer separate in the PSD if possible, please.
Thank you very much!
